discount_code_text: Colorado Mountain School (CMS) is the premiere mountain guide service and technical mountain school in Colorado and beyond. CMS has many great amenities including frequent course offerings in Estes Park, Boulder, and Denver, on-site accommodations, and a full-time operations staff. This offer includes AIARE avalanche training, rock, ski, ice and mountaineering programs (custom guiding, AMGA training, hut-based avalanche courses, and international programs excluded). View all terms and conditions here .
